turns.instruction:
Build the attached two-storey 1 by 2 bay frame in OpenSees. All columns have asymmetric 400 by 500 mm rectangular sections. Both (0,0) column segments initially have a 90-degree local section roll. Roof loads are global Fx=15 kN, Fy=10 kN and Mz=+8 kN.m at (6,10,7.2); all beams carry downward 8 kN/m. Report global Ux, Uz and Uy at n1-2-2 (6,10,7.2) m, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at n0-0-0 (0,0,0) m, for every listed case and combination.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Remove the 90-degree local-axis roll only from first-storey column c0-0-1 at X=Y=0, Z=0 to 3.6 m. Its roll is now zero. Keep the upper segment and every other column orientation unchanged; preserve all global load vectors including the +8 kN.m Z torque. Reanalyze. Report global Ux, Uz and Uy at n1-2-2 (6,10,7.2) m, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at n0-0-0 (0,0,0) m, for every listed case and combination.

Increase only the global Y lateral-force group by 10%, so roof-Y becomes Fy=+11 kN. Preserve the current local axes, Fx=15 kN, Mz=+8 kN.m and beam loads. Reanalyze. Report global Ux, Uz and Uy at n1-2-2 (6,10,7.2) m, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at n0-0-0 (0,0,0) m, for every listed case and combination.
